comment: The sprites the MSX2 shows as hardware sprites (AGENTS.md §5, §10 M5), besides Ranger Vale,
whose sprite comes from player.json. 'rom' are cut into the ROM's sprite bank now; 'later' are
cut only for the palette's order and the report, and go into the ROM with the milestone that
brings them (M6, M7). Every sprite's frames are cut into 16x16 blocks of two layers, a colour a
line each and their OR where they overlap: three colours a line. A line with more, or with three
the OR cannot make, has pixels changed; 'accepted' is how many changed pixels each sprite is
allowed, all its frames together, after looking at them (build/gen/sprites.txt lists every one,
build/gen/sprites.png shows them). The converter fails when a sprite changes more than that.
